mentions.name: Maglev
mentions.description: Next-generation server software from the OneBusAway suite that adds support for newer transit data formats, such as GTFS-Flex, so demand-responsive transit systems can be shown on the map.
mentions.source_excerpt: Our next-generation server software, Maglev, is adding support for newer transit data formats, like GTFS-Flex so that we can show demand responsive transit systems on the map.
mentions.author: aaronbrethorst
